title: Dawnice 225kWh ESS Empowers a Dutch Equestrian Farm (March 2026)
summary: A 225kWh outdoor battery with a 125kW Solis inverter at an equestrian facility in the Netherlands.
challenge: Agricultural businesses in the Netherlands face strict carbon emission rules and volatile energy prices, and a working stable cannot absorb interruptions to its daily routine.
solution: A 225kWh outdoor energy storage system paired with a 125kW Solis hybrid inverter.
result: Commissioned in March 2026 as an on-site microgrid for the facility.
